name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Born and raised in Geneva, Isabelle has always been driven by ambition and a desire for the finer things in life. She's carved out a successful career as a professional downhill skier, achieving national recognition and a comfortable income. While she enjoys the spotlight and the perks that come with her profession, she fiercely guards her privacy and prefers to keep her personal life out of the public eye.

Isabelle is looking for a partner who understands the demands of her career and shares her appreciation for a sophisticated lifestyle. Although she may come across as self-centered at times, she deeply values loyalty and commitment. She desires a traditional family structure with children and marriage, but also needs someone who respects her independence and gives her space. She needs a partner who can provide quality time and attention, and be comfortable navigating her active social life.

physical.skinTone: Fair, with a slight tan from outdoor training
physical.hairStyle: Long, sleek, often pulled back in a high ponytail during the day, but worn down and styled for evening events
physical.description: Isabelle has a strong, athletic build and an elegant posture. Her striking hazel eyes and high cheekbones give her a captivating presence.

meetingContext: At a VIP event for a luxury watch brand sponsoring a motorsport team.
firstImpression: Isabelle exudes confidence as she navigates the room, her designer dress and expensive jewelry hinting at her success; her eyes scan the room with an air of careful assessment.
loveLanguage: Quality Time. She needs undivided attention and meaningful experiences to feel truly connected.
